applied_through: openbot.create_agent, openbot.update_agents, openbot.update_profile, openbot.create_channel (official tools); workspace AGENTS.md = Instructions

common_settings.model_note: Haiku for the pilot budget; Sonnet 5.5 is one update_agents call away and was not measured

backup_models.note: backups stay on provider claude: harness hooks exist only for Claude Code

common_settings.access_note: OpenBot 'workspace' access makes Claude skip the workspace .claude/settings.json, which disables the harness hooks; least privilege comes from the harness sandbox (kch enroll)
common_settings.memory: harness PROJECT/AGENT knowledge via kch; OpenBot channel memory isolated per channel
common_settings.local_scripts: on only during the scripted pilot; off for normal use

project_binding.channel: one OpenBot channel '<project> · V5' per project, isolated: true, lead = Product Lead

rollback: Legacy agents and their config were not changed; backup of all agent/channel/routine config: ~/backups/agents-config-20261118-0105
To remove the V5 team from a project: Owner DELETE /v1/projects/{p}/conversations/{kind}/{id} and supersede open tasks

To stop the harness: systemctl --user disable --now kc-harness (enrolled workspaces then refuse tools: fail-closed). There is no unenroll command: to free an agent, delete the harness keys (hooks, sandbox, permissions.deny, env) from <workspace>/.claude/settings.json, or delete that file for the four V5 Leads (they had none before enrollment)
